note: The textbook case for the stated ICP. Private equity, part-owner of the business, personally leading his group's IPO — 'already successful, owns their own business or equivalent' is met literally. Income is met by conduct rather than by claim: he asked about currency and payment structure, took the $1,200/month option in stride, and never once pushed on the number. Health is the neglected corner rather than a crisis — he is active eight-plus hours a week across squash and soccer but has never sustained structured strength work, and the deficit he names is muscle mass, not weight. And it is explicitly good-to-great in his own words: "Today, I'm quite fit and athletic, but no muscle mass." The not_deconditioned exclusion does not bite at all — he is an attacking winger playing Sunday-league soccer. Graded core with four criteria affirmatively evidenced and the fifth an exclusion he clearly does not trigger. The instructive part is that the best-fitting prospect in the batch did not close, which points at the process rather than at targeting.
